name: spreadsheet
description: Open spreadsheet documents, progressively load atomic operation schemas, and execute bounded work through shared document handles.

interface.shortDescription: Read and write spreadsheets through a progressive protocol.
interface.longDescription: Give the model bounded spreadsheet inspection, validation, creation, update, filtering, conversion, and server-side row-selection capabilities through a format-neutral document protocol.
capabilities: XLS, XLSX, XLSM, XLSB, Excel template, and ODS inspection
Cell finding and conditional row filtering
Server-side row filtering, column projection, constants, and value conversion
